title: ReImagine brings image transformations to mobile
summary:
A mobile image app and Gemini image editing joined a round of fixes for tiers, Flux responses, and Enter request handling.

Community contributor ismailazdad added ReImagine, a React Native app for transforming one image with kontext or combining two to four with gptimage. It keeps local version history and lets users save or share results.

The image model registry gained nanobanana for image-to-image generation through Enter, with a 2048-pixel maximum side length. Gemini refusals now retain their specific feedback instead of becoming generic errors.

Seed, Flower, and Nectar tier detection now uses the updated subscription products. The tier panel reads the product name and daily Pollen amount from Polar rather than showing hardcoded values.

highlights.title: Gemini image transformations
highlights.text: Use `nanobanana` for image-to-image generation through Enter, with output up to 2048 pixels on a side. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).
